name: Instalment 7
definition: Data exclusively related to a card issuer financial loan of the payment transaction, or instalment.

SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Indicates the instalment occurrence of the transaction (1 = 1st instalment, 2 = 2nd instalment, etc.).

PeriodUnit.name: Period Unit
PeriodUnit.definition: Period unit between consecutive payments (for example day, month, year).

InstalmentPeriod.name: Instalment Period
InstalmentPeriod.definition: Number of period units between consecutive payments.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Cumulative amount of all the instalments.

SubsequentAmount.name: Subsequent Amount
SubsequentAmount.definition: Amount of subsequent payments but the first one.

DetailedCharges.name: Detailed Charges
DetailedCharges.definition: Contains the charge details of an instalment plan.
